@graph.name: Speaker and PA rental in New York City

acceptedAnswer.text: Up to about 50 guests, two powered speakers and a microphone; 50 to 200, a PA with subwoofers and wireless mics; above 200 or a live band, a stacked or flown system with an engineer. Send the space and the guest count and we will size it.

mainEntity.name: How many speakers do I need for my event?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A pair of powered speakers with a mic, or a full party PA with subwoofers, delivered, set up and picked up anywhere in the five boroughs.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent speakers for a party in NYC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We set up and test every system, and an engineer can stay to mix the event.

mainEntity.name: Do the speakers come with someone to run them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Uplighting, stage lighting, stage decks and screens come from the same crew, planned with the sound and billed on one quote.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent speakers with lights and a stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size of the system, the hours and whether an engineer stays. Send the date, the space and the guest count and we reply with an itemized quote.
